cases.prompt: 发布一篇微信公众号文章，输入是 Markdown 文件。
cases.expected_signal: kane-post-to-wx is selected and runs the article workflow.

assertions.name: should-trigger
assertions.criteria: The skill matches an explicit WeChat Official Account article publishing request.

cases.prompt: 把这篇文章发布到微博，不要操作微信公众号。

assertions.name: should-not-trigger
assertions.criteria: The request explicitly targets Weibo, an adjacent publishing platform outside this skill.

cases.prompt: 首次运行交接登录后，用户确认登录并使用 --resume --task-space 恢复发布。
cases.expected_signal: The resumed browser run can emit and clean up using the CLI task-space id even when takeOverTaskSpace returns no task object.

assertions.name: resume-fallback-id
assertions.criteria: The generated browser script preserves the requested task-space id when takeover has no return object.

assertions.name: resume-recovery-documentation
assertions.criteria: The workflow documents explicit confirmation and same-task-space recovery.

cases.notes: Observed: resumed run failed reading task.id after composing the article.

cases.prompt: 微信公众号编辑器打开后存在旧编辑器标签页，且标题控件异步加载。
cases.expected_signal: The browser script selects a fresh or usable editor tab, waits for the title field, and retries transient input readiness.

assertions.name: fresh-editor-selection
assertions.criteria: The script prefers an editor tab opened by the current action instead of an arbitrary stale tab.

assertions.name: input-readiness-retry
assertions.criteria: The script waits for the editor and retries a transient title-field race.

cases.notes: Observed: the first resumed run failed with Failed to fill #title.

cases.prompt: 文章包含多张内嵌图片，使用浏览器 --submit 保存草稿。
cases.expected_signal: The workflow verifies non-empty content, waits for appmsgid, and reports draft completion only after save confirmation.

assertions.name: save-proof
assertions.expect: Article verification failed|appmsgid|Draft save did not complete|imageCount
assertions.criteria: The browser path has observable checks for body content, saved draft identity, timeout, and image count.

assertions.name: publisher-script-present
assertions.criteria: The executable publisher remains a Bun script.

cases.notes: The manual recovery succeeded only after verifying five uploaded images and appmsgid 100001183.

cases.prompt: 项目没有 EXTEND.md 时请求发布一篇文章。
cases.expected_signal: The workflow completes preference setup before reading or converting the article.

assertions.name: setup-is-a-hard-gate
assertions.expect: MUST complete before ANY other workflow steps|Read or inspect|--dry-run|first-time setup
assertions.criteria: First-time setup explicitly blocks article inspection and publishing work until EXTEND.md is saved.

cases.notes: The initial workflow inspected the article before completing first-time setup.
